findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_spec, create_tests_from_spec · Private data: create_tests, create_spec, create_tests_from_spec, create_spec_for_function, create_mock_for_function, validate_spec, validate_config, get_client_info, create_agent_instructions · Public sink: create_tests, create_spec, create_tests_from_spec, create_spec_for_function, create_mock_for_function · Destructive: create_tests, create_spec, create_tests_from_spec, create_spec_for_function, validate_spec, create_agent_instructions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_spec, create_tests_from_spec · Private data: create_tests, create_spec, create_tests_from_spec, create_spec_for_function, create_mock_for_function, validate_spec, validate_config, get_client_info, create_agent_instructions · Public sink: create_tests, create_spec, create_tests_from_spec, create_spec_for_function, create_mock_for_function · Destructive: create_tests, create_spec, create_tests_from_spec, create_spec_for_function, validate_spec, create_agent_instructions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
